questions.rawQuestionHtml:

  2. The increase in the number of Millennial car buyers from $2015$ to $2020$ is less than the decrease in the number of Gen $\text{X}$ car buyers from $2010$ to $2015$.
  3. The increase in the number of Millennial car buyers from $2010$ to $2015$ is more than the decrease in the number of Gen $\text{X}$ car buyers from $2010$ to $2015$.
  4. The decrease in the number of Gen $\text{X}$ car buyers from $2015$ to $2020$ is more than the increase in the number of Millennial car buyers from $2010$ to $2015$.

The increase in the number of Millennial car buyers from $2010$ to $2015$ is more than the decrease in the number of Gen $\text{X}$ car buyers from $2010$ to $2015$.

The bar chart gives the batting averages of $\mathrm{VK}$ and $\mathrm{RS}$ for $11$ calendar years from $2012$ to $2022$. Considering that $2015$ and $2019$ are world cup years, which one of the following options is true?

  1. $\mathrm{RS}$ has a higher yearly batting average than that of $\mathrm{VK}$ in every world cup year.
  2. $\mathrm{VK}$ has a higher yearly batting average than that of $\mathrm{RS}$ in every world cup year.
  3. $\mathrm{VK’s}$ yearly batting average is consistently higher than that of $\mathrm{RS}$ between the two world cup years.
  4. $\mathrm{RS’s}$ yearly batting average is consistently higher than that of $\mathrm{VK}$ in the last three years.
options: $\mathrm{RS}$ has a higher yearly batting average than that of $\mathrm{VK}$ in every world cup year.
$\mathrm{VK}$ has a higher yearly batting average than that of $\mathrm{RS}$ in every world cup year.
$\mathrm{VK’s}$ yearly batting average is consistently higher than that of $\mathrm{RS}$ between the two world cup years.
$\mathrm{RS’s}$ yearly batting average is consistently higher than that of $\mathrm{VK}$ in the last three years.

structuredOptions.label: A
structuredOptions.text: $\mathrm{RS}$ has a higher yearly batting average than that of $\mathrm{VK}$ in every world cup year.
structuredOptions.html: $\mathrm{RS}$ has a higher yearly batting average than that of $\mathrm{VK}$ in every world cup year.

structuredOptions.label: B
structuredOptions.text: $\mathrm{VK}$ has a higher yearly batting average than that of $\mathrm{RS}$ in every world cup year.
structuredOptions.html: $\mathrm{VK}$ has a higher yearly batting average than that of $\mathrm{RS}$ in every world cup year.

structuredOptions.label: C
structuredOptions.text: $\mathrm{VK’s}$ yearly batting average is consistently higher than that of $\mathrm{RS}$ between the two world cup years.
structuredOptions.html: $\mathrm{VK’s}$ yearly batting average is consistently higher than that of $\mathrm{RS}$ between the two world cup years.

structuredOptions.label: D
structuredOptions.text: $\mathrm{RS’s}$ yearly batting average is consistently higher than that of $\mathrm{VK}$ in the last three years.
structuredOptions.html: $\mathrm{RS’s}$ yearly batting average is consistently higher than that of $\mathrm{VK}$ in the last three years.
